# FLX-2113: the run directory does not belong to the plan it holds

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

A run directory is named by the run id derived from its plan's own planDigest, so the directory name and the plan inside it are two spellings of one fact. When they disagree, the directory was copied, renamed or assembled from another run's artifacts, and every later binding check would be comparing files that all came from the same copy. Re-run `fluxsim plan` and apply into the directory it names.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2113
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
